_note: Starting Wayfarer and movement tuning. walkSpeed is in tiles per second; walkFrameTicks is how many 60 Hz ticks each walk frame lasts. feet is the box that bumps into things (for the Wayfarer and townspeople), in pixels from the top-left of the 8x16 sprite: a narrower box makes one-tile gaps easier to walk through. nudge is how far (in pixels) he slides sideways into an opening when he walks straight into a wall next to one: x when walking up or down, y when walking left or right; 0 turns it off. xpRewards is the experience for learning a new topic and for discovering a place (from the design doc; levels arrive in milestone 5).
